notify_on_copy.description: Show a notification when a character is copied to the clipboard
notify_on_copy.label: Notify on Copy

paste_after_copy.description: Also type the character into the focused window after copying, using wtype. Works in terminals and GUI apps without relying on a paste shortcut.
paste_after_copy.label: Paste After Copy

paste_delay_ms.description: Wait this long after the launcher closes before typing, so focus has returned to the previous window
paste_delay_ms.label: Paste Delay (ms)
